1. Exact hypotheses and proof
==============================
Use signature (-,+,+,+) and the physical metric g seen by all known matter.
The dark realization class is

 S=integral sqrt(-g) [M^2 R/2+P(phi^A,B^{AB})]+S_known[g],
 B^{AB}=g^{mu nu} partial_mu phi^A partial_nu phi^B.       (1.1)

There are arbitrarily many but finitely many real scalar components. Their
internal space is a finite real orthogonal SO(3) representation with any
integer spins and multiplicities. P is smooth and invariant under this
common internal rotation. Material spin-1 fields are independently shift
symmetric. On the homogeneous isotropic background, singlets may depend
on time, the only spatial field gradients are

 b_i^{aI}=beta_a delta_i^I, beta_a=lambda_a/a,
 phi^{aI}=lambda_a x^I,

and higher-spin fields have zero background. Nonzero invariant constant
background values belong to spin 0. General P cross-couplings, entropy
and higher-spin order-parameter fluctuations are admitted.

Let P_AB and H_AB,CD denote the first and second B differentials, with
symmetric-matrix differential convention. For local field directions u,v,
S_n(u)=b_n tensor u+u tensor b_n, and S_0 uses q^A=partial_0 phi^A. The
principal forms are

 C_n(u,v)=-2 P(u,v)-H(S_n(u),S_n(v)),
 K(u,v)=-2 P(u,v)+H(S_0(u),S_0(v)).                       (1.2)

Require K>0 on the full field space, C_n>=0 for every spatial Fourier
direction, regular causal hyperbolic evolution and lower-order background
stability on the interval considered. C_n is Fourier/Legendre–Hadamard
positivity, not a claim that the full block C_ij is pointwise PSD on all
independent gradient matrices. With homogeneous coefficients it gives
nonnegative integrated frozen spatial principal energy by Fourier
decomposition. No positive lower sound-speed gap is required by the exact
theorem. Gauge-constrained or singular auxiliary fields, higher derivatives,
curvature in P, metric derivatives, and loop/nonlocal response are excluded.

metric Green operator and its calibrated known-source coupling, with the

tensor initial response, on an interval and an open spatial momentum band.

matter coupling: in that frame known matter is conformally coupled to
